reviewer: AI agent visual layout review; not a human regulatory audit
method: Rendered all 13 flagged physical pages with Poppler; inspected their single-column text, metadata rows and numbered footnotes. Also inspected B-10 p5 and SRP30 p12 at larger scale. Compared to extracted text.
disposition: Retain page text. No flagged page needs OCR or table reconstruction for this fixed corpus. The heuristic flags indentation, not confirmed data tables. Flags alone do not block chunking.
known_artifacts: B-10 p5 and other source pages contain literal HTML link markup in the official PDF rendition; retained verbatim for offset provenance.
Basel PDF includes typographic ligatures and footnotes; canonical extraction is preserved.
Basel PDF generation label reads 07/10/2026 while retrieval timestamp and corpus reference are 2026-10-06; generated date is not the in-force date (2019-12-15).
Review checked layout and extraction spot samples, not every statement or legal applicability.
